scope: Owned additive PC authoring target; no shipping Config or mobile/web requirement

requirements.rhi: DX12 SM6 on verified compatible hardware, not Microsoft Basic Render Driver
requirements.nanite: Hardware support including 64-bit atomics; eligible opaque static derivatives only
requirements.lumen: Compatible hardware/RHI; software tracing requires generated mesh distance fields; hardware tracing requires project support and eligible GPU
requirements.profileActivation: Separate hardware inspection and owner-approved renderer integration; this artifact does not activate settings

materialPolicy: Physical pre-scaled UV multiplier1; scanned basecolour sRGB, roughness/normal data; GL green inversion once; modeled corrugation scan normal omitted

preview.interpretation: Requested/default console values do not imply hardware support or active rendering. No preview renderer settings changed.
